content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Gujarat Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Gujarat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for ESIC Gujarat Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 13 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the ESIC Gujarat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 25 vacancies for the posts of Full Time Specialist, Part Time Specialist, and Senior Resident in ESIC Gujarat Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: For the Senior Resident post, candidates need a PG Degree or PG Diploma in the concerned specialty. MBBS graduates with at least 2 years of experience in the specialty are also considered if PG qualified candidates are unavailable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for Full Time and Part Time Specialists?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Full Time and Part Time Specialists is 69 years. For Senior Residents, the maximum age limit is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Full Time Specialist post?
faq.answer: The salary for a Full Time Specialist is Rs. 60,000/- fixed per month, with additional remuneration for emergency calls and extra hours.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Part Time Specialist and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Both Part Time Specialist and Senior Resident posts offer a salary of Rs. 1,35,129/- fixed per month, along with transport allowance as per rules.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Ankleshwar, Gujarat. Specific venue details can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any application fees for ESIC Gujarat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring two recent passport-size photographs, one set of attested photocopies, and originals of all testimonials, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.
